description: Full text of one published Southwest Pitch page or article, as plain text with headings. Pass the URL or slug. Long pages come back in parts: pass next_offset as offset to continue.

offset.description: Where to resume a long page. Pass the next_offset value from the previous response. Default 0.

url_or_slug.description: The full page URL from a search result, or just its slug, such as "tryouts".

name: pitch-get-page
title: Read a page (Southwest Pitch)
